patterns.description: Customers frequently complain about poor food quality or inconsistent dishes.
Negative feedback regarding unhelpful, rude, or inattentive staff attitude.
Dissatisfaction with high prices or perceived poor value for money.
Complaints regarding long waiting times for tables or service.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently complain about poor food quality or inconsistent dishes.
root_causes.cause: Lack of standardized recipes and quality control in the kitchen during peak hours.

root_causes.pattern: Negative feedback regarding unhelpful, rude, or inattentive staff attitude.
root_causes.cause: Understaffing leading to employee burnout and inadequate customer service training.

root_causes.pattern: Dissatisfaction with high prices or perceived poor value for money.
root_causes.cause: Pricing strategy does not align with portion sizes or overall dining experience.

root_causes.pattern: Complaints regarding long waiting times for tables or service.
root_causes.cause: Inefficient front-of-house management, table turnover delays, and kitchen bottlenecks.
